{{Quote|The Nine Ruling Families are like any other families. Blood and merit create siblings and cousins and ranking distants. Some are released, others are rematched, others are born to trial. The same as any other family.|Aide Chaf'ees'aklaio, to Dean Jinzler|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
'''Cousin''' was the second-highest [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] rank of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. In the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] hierarchy, it was situated above the rank of [[Ranking distant/Legends|ranking distant]] but below the rank of [[Sibling (Chiss)|sibling]]. Although Chiss could be granted the rank of cousin based on merits alone, most were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the position.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Survivor's Quest Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> [[Aide/Legends|Aide]] [[Chaf'ees'aklaio]], core name "Feesa," of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] explained to [[Dean Jinzler]] how Chiss families were set up. Feesa described how the family rank of cousin could be granted based on merits alone, or by blood.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
